about.title: About the Vietnam Fatherland Front Committee of Phong Hai Commune
about.subtitle: A solid bridge between the Party, the Government and the people of all ethnic groups in Phong Hai Commune in building and defending the Homeland.
about.history1: Formed from the early days of the commune's re-establishment, the Fatherland Front Committee of Phong Hai Commune has always played a core role in uniting and mobilizing all classes of people and promoting the great national unity bloc.
about.history2: Through different periods, the committee has continuously renewed its content and methods of operation, staying close to the lives of local ethnic communities and contributing significantly to local socio-economic development.
about.quote: Unity, unity, great unity. Success, success, great success.
about.fn1Desc: Gather and build the great national unity bloc, exercise democracy and strengthen social consensus.
about.fn2Desc: Represent and protect the legitimate rights and interests of the people; contribute to building the Party and State.
about.fn3Desc: Communicate and mobilize the people to exercise their right to mastery and carry out the Party's guidelines.
about.orgNote: Together with many members representing affiliated organizations and exemplary individuals.
about.roleChairman: Chairman of the Commune Fatherland Front Committee

about.ctaDesc: We always listen to and value every response from the people.
